page.heading: Offi ce of the Registrar Milton College
page.paragraph: I am writing to confirm that your placement term has now been formally closed and that the result has been entered on your permanent record.
The grade awarded for the term is 76. The evaluation recorded alongside it is Satisfactory. Both entries are final and will appear on any transcript issued from this point forward.
Should any part of this record require correction, please contact this office in writing within thirty days.
